# cb:b409

> Logical underpinnings of code and data decisions trace through a three-layer chain: policy beliefs (kind:policy, type:primitive) state what must be true; contract beliefs (contract:true, type:implication) derive rules from policies via deps and express them in DSL (rules/invariants); code modules implement the contract rules. Each layer links to the next: contracts dep on policies; contracts cite their implementing code modules via subjects. Discovery is bidirectional via DAG traversal — no back-pointer field is needed because depended-on-by is computable from deps.
